credential_protection_catalog_search: Find rules by name, target or ID

credential_protection_catalog_no_results: No rules match this search. Clear the search to browse all rules.
credential_protection_catalog_path_note: File-specific rules remain listed for completeness. Model text and the tester have no trusted file path, so these rules may not apply.
credential_protection_rule_conditions_he: These are the actual snapshot fields, including path restrictions, capture group, keywords, filters, component proximity, priority and reporting controls. Empty fields mean no condition of that kind; validate scripts are not executed.
credential_protection_rule_no_expression: No standalone text expression; inspect the path and component conditions.
credential_protection_discoveries_intro: One entry per client interaction that created new credential protection. Reusing valid protection or restoring placeholders does not count; recreation after expiry can count again.
credential_protection_discoveries_retent: Diagnostic summaries follow observation retention and may be incomplete. They are not a security audit, contain no credential values or message excerpts, and do not include unrecorded historical discoveries.
credential_protection_discoveries_empty: No new credential discoveries in the available observations.
credential_protection_discoveries_gap: Observation data is incomplete. Missing records do not mean no credentials were discovered.
credential_protection_off_brief: Turning protection off stops new detection and replacement. Existing valid placeholders still restore until expiry.
credential_protection_tester_intro: Try a single key or a complete configuration or message fragment against this instance’s current rules, even when protection is off.
credential_protection_tester_flow: Only submitted text is sent to your Stravia instance—not to a model provider or credential-validation service. Stravia does not save the input or include it in diagnostics or test history.
credential_protection_tester_limits: This tests readable text only, without a trusted file path, extra decoding or online validation. It does not search saved credentials, create protection mappings or discovery records, or change settings. Existing admin request limits apply.
credential_protection_tester_failed: Matching test failed. No result is available; this is not a no-match result.
credential_protection_tester_none: No existing rule matched. This does not mean the text is safe or a credential is invalid.
credential_protection_tester_matches: {count} matches. Select a result to locate it in the input.
reversible_redaction_summary: Automatically identify and replace keys and other credentials sent to models, then restore them in replies and tool calls to reduce exposure.
reversible_redaction_scope: Off by default. Enabling applies to every valid Stravia API Key, without per-key exemptions, client changes, or Transparent Injection settings.
reversible_redaction_load_failed: Credential protection settings could not be loaded. Retry before making changes.
reversible_redaction_protection: Stravia replaces detected credentials in readable model-bound text: system instructions, user and historical messages, tool arguments, tool results, and internal model requests. Known secrets from valid mappings for the same API Key are also replaced wherever their exact text appears, including elsewhere in the request where a secret is first detected.
reversible_redaction_mapping: The same API Key reuses a secret’s placeholder while its mapping is valid, across conversations and restarts. Sharing an API Key shares access to its mappings; other keys cannot restore them. Mapping retention follows history retention rules. Unknown or expired placeholders remain unchanged.
reversible_redaction_failures: Detection, replacement, or mapping storage failures explicitly fail the request or terminate an active stream; Stravia does not bypass protection and send plaintext instead.
reversible_redaction_off: Turning this off stops new detection and replacement, including known-secret matching. Existing valid placeholders still restore in answers, client tool arguments, and platform tool execution arguments until expiry. Mappings are not deleted, and new outgoing requests—including tool results—are no longer protected by this feature.
reversible_redaction_tools_warning: Tools receive restored credentials. A model can put a placeholder in a URL or other tool argument and cause a tool to send the restored secret to an external destination. Keep existing tool permissions and outbound controls in place; this toggle is not credential revocation or an exfiltration barrier.
reversible_redaction_limits: This protects detected credential text, not all secrets, personal information, or business data. False positives and missed secrets are possible. Images, audio, video, binary attachments, and opaque payloads are not scanned. Local mappings and client-visible history can contain plaintext; this feature does not encrypt the database or protect against someone reading local storage or backups.

provider_model_editor_error_non_finite_n: Provider Model metadata contains a non-finite number.
provider_model_editor_error_unsupported_: Provider Model metadata contains an unsupported value.
model_editor_thinking_levels_help: Derived from enabled destination mappings. A level is supported only when every enabled destination provides a non-hidden control.
model_editor_thinking_map_help: Map each Route level to the control sent to this destination.
model_editor_thinking_regenerate_confirm: Replace every override with mappings generated from the current Provider Model snapshot?
backend_error_thinking_level_coverage: Target {provider_id}/{model_id} has no control for open Thinking Level {level}. Override the mapping or close that Route level.
backend_error_thinking_control_unreprese: Target {provider_id}/{model_id} cannot write Thinking Level {level} through protocol {protocol}. Choose a supported control kind.
overview_send_first_request: Client traffic and rankings will appear after a request reaches Stravia.
media_understanding_add_logical_model: Add an enabled logical Model whose every Target accepts image input before enabling Media Understanding.
providers_model_nowhere_without_provider: A Model has nowhere to go until you connect a Provider.
stats_send_first_request: Send the first request to see usage.
model_specification_declaration_caveat: This is the saved Provider Model specification. It is a recorded declaration, not a tested capability or a guarantee that the current connection path supports it.
model_specification_attachment_caveat: Attachments are declared separately from input modalities and do not imply that every file type is accepted.
model_specification_integer_required: Enter a non-negative whole number of tokens.
observation_clear_filters_help: Clear filters to restore the full causal forest.
observation_clear_warning: Deletes completed and interrupted interactions and all rejected requests in the retained window. Running and client-waiting interactions stay active and are reported as skipped.
observation_debug_disable_retains: Turning Debug off affects only later admissions. Existing traces remain until retention cleanup.
observation_debug_fidelity: Debug records are redacted application-protocol and canonical checkpoint captures, not TLS, packet, or HTTP/2 frame captures.
observation_debug_warning: Debug may retain prompts, tool arguments, results, and business data after credential redaction. Credentials formed by joining business text across messages may remain. Each Run is capped at {run_limit}; all retained traces at {total_limit}; traces remain for {retention_days} days. Confirm every enable action.
observation_filters_description: Matching returns each complete root DAG. Nonmatching ancestors remain as subdued causal context.
observation_history_cleared: Cleared {interactions} interactions and {rejections} rejected requests; preserved {skipped} active interactions.
observation_moved_to_latest: This chain moved to a newer time page · Open latest
observation_new_requests_appear: New requests will appear here. Pre-upgrade request logs were intentionally not migrated.
observation_no_rejections_description: Authentication, decoding, and protocol failures before Run admission will appear here.
observation_node_keyboard_help: Press Enter or Space to inspect this interaction. Press Escape to close details.
observation_page_summary: Trace live Connect Client Interactions as stable causal topology, then inspect Runs, attempts, tools, delivery, and confirmed usage.
observation_partial_traces_warning: {count} retained Debug traces are partial. Their missing reasons remain visible in details and bundles.
observation_refresh_anchor: Refresh and anchor a new current window
observation_rejections_description: Pre-admission failures remain separate from authenticated Interactions and Generation Chain.
